allDialogues.dialogue: Welcome back to the warehouse, young master. Your grandfather left quite the mess.
These things aren’t just junk. Every item has a story, if you’re willing to listen.
Rowan used to say that the Last Compass never took a job they couldn’t walk away from. That stopped being true.
Some of these items might be better off unsold. Not everything can be priced in gold.
If you ever finish sorting all this, maybe you’ll finally learn why he stopped coming home on time.
